tools.name: find_clinics
tools.description: Find UK clinics that can prescribe cannabis-based medicines, by name, town or postcode. Use it for 'which clinics…' questions and to compare published consultation fees. Returns up to 25 clinics, each with its Findabis page URL, town and postcode, first and follow-up consultation fees, consultation

tools.name: find_pharmacies
tools.description: Find UK pharmacies that dispense cannabis-based medicines against a prescription a clinic has already issued, by name, town or postcode, optionally only those that deliver. Returns up to 25 pharmacies with page URL, town and postcode, delivery and collection, and review score. A pharmacy cannot pres

tools.name: find_products
tools.description: Find cannabis-based medicines on the UK market by product, brand or strain name, or by dose form. Returns up to 25 products with page URL, slug, brand, dose form, THC and CBD content, and the latest price a UK pharmacy charged (naming no pharmacy) when Findabis publishes one. It does not return stoc

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Everything public about one product, by its slug from find_products or search_findabis: dose form and strength, strain and brand, terpenes, what it contains (carrier oil, allergens, capsule shell), dosage and storage notes, patient leaflets and FAQs, and its price range across UK pharmacies when Fin

tools.name: find_strains
tools.description: Find cannabis strain profiles by name or genetics (Indica, Sativa or Hybrid). Returns up to 25 strains with page URL, slug, genetics and THC and CBD ranges. A strain is a plant lineage, not something a pharmacy dispenses — use find_products for that. Findabis publishes no effects, medical uses or si

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: The public facts on one clinic, pharmacy, strain or brand page, by `kind` and the page `slug` from find_clinics, find_pharmacies, find_strains or search_findabis. Clinic: address, consultation types and fees, published price list, CQC rating, which patients its policy takes, partner pharmacies. Phar

tools.name: search_findabis
tools.description: One text search across clinics, pharmacies, products, strains and brands. Use it when you do not yet know which kind the question is about, or to turn a name into a slug; then call the specific tool, which returns more detail. Returns names, kinds, slugs and page URLs only — no prices, stock or medi
